name: cache-bell
description: Keeps a long Claude Code session from re-sending its whole context after a break. Before the prompt cache expires it asks, then renews the cache or compacts the conversation.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to pause the plugin without uninstalling it. Cache Bell, made by the Holler Bell team. hollerbell.com

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: notify: countdown and question only. keep: renew the cache silently, three times at most, never compact. prepare-compact: ask, renew twice, ask again, announce, compact. compact-only: compact before the cache expires. custom: use the five options below.

ask.title: Ask (custom mode)
ask.description: When to ask during one idle period. first: the first time only. every: every time. never: not at all.

maxRenewals.title: Renewals (custom mode)
maxRenewals.description: How many times the cache is renewed in one idle period, 0 to 3. Three is the most in any mode, counted by the requests sent: every renewal is a request on your plan that reads the whole context, and one that gets no answer is tried once more only within those three.

renewMethod.title: Renewal method (custom mode)
renewMethod.description: fork: a silent side request that leaves no trace in the conversation. none: do not keep the cache warm.

prepareBeforeCompact.title: Announce the compaction (custom mode)
prepareBeforeCompact.description: Tell the session that a compaction is coming, in a turn of its own, right before it.

compact.title: Compact (custom mode)
compact.description: Compact once the renewals are used up.

preparePrompt.title: Announcement
preparePrompt.description: What the session is told before a compaction. Empty = nothing is said.
preparePrompt.default: This conversation will be compacted right after this turn. Nothing is needed from you: a one-line reply is enough.

pingPrompt.title: Keep-alive prompt
pingPrompt.default: This request only keeps the prompt cache warm. Answer with the single word: ok

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: Instructions for the summary, as after /compact. {time} and {idle} are filled in. Empty = a plain compaction.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto: read from the session's transcript. 5m or 1h: set by hand.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Below this the plugin does nothing about an expiring cache: a small context is left alone. A compaction Claude asks for is not affected.

compactCountdown.title: Compaction countdown (seconds)
compactCountdown.description: How long you have to cancel a compaction Claude asked for, 5 to 3600 seconds. Claude may name a time of its own with a request, 10 to 600 seconds, shorter or longer than this.

sessionCompact.title: Compaction asked for by the session
sessionCompact.description: What happens when Claude itself asks for a compaction (the compact skill). confirm: you are asked and it compacts when the countdown ends without your answer. wait: you are asked and the request is dropped unless you say Compact. auto: it compacts right after the turn. off: Claude cannot ask.

askLeadMinutes.title: Ask ahead (minutes)
askLeadMinutes.description: How long before the time to act the cache question appears. 0 = automatic: 15 minutes on an hour-long cache, 30 seconds on a five-minute one.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where the countdown shows. band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. both: in both. off: nowhere.

showBelowMinutes.title: Show the countdown below (minutes)
showBelowMinutes.description: The countdown of a warm cache appears once this many minutes or fewer are left. 0 = always shown. A cold cache, a question and the plugin at work are always shown.

readTranscript.title: Read the cache lifetime from the transcript
readTranscript.description: The lifetime the API really granted (5 minutes or 1 hour) is written only in the session's transcript; the plugin reads the usage figures of its last lines, nothing of what was said. Off: the lifetime is taken from the Claude Code settings, a model switch or the ttl option, and may be wrong when the API grants less than was asked for.
